guardrail_rules.label: Block hallucinated action claims
guardrail_rules.description: Blocks responses that claim a refund or action was performed without evidence of a real workflow execution.

guardrail_rules.label: Transaction context detection
guardrail_rules.description: Detects when the user query contains a real transaction/order/case identifier. Used to avoid false positives in hallucination detection.

guardrail_rules.label: Strip urgency questions
guardrail_rules.description: Remove questions like 'Is this urgent?' from customer-facing text. Urgency is an internal triage signal.

guardrail_rules.label: Strip async follow-up promises
guardrail_rules.description: Remove promises like 'I have forwarded your case' or 'I will get back to you' that the system cannot fulfil.
patterns: I\s+will\s+(?:get back to you|follow up|notify you|let you know)\b[^.!?]*[.!?]?\s*

guardrail_rules.label: Hide system jargon
guardrail_rules.description: Remove internal system terms like 'workflow', 'FSM', 'pipeline', 'slots' from customer-facing text.

guardrail_rules.label: Hide internal file names
guardrail_rules.description: Remove references to internal files like 'BankFAQs.csv' or 'refunds_policy.yaml' from customer-facing text.
